Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner's analysis incorrectly identified Mark Bell as the performer of the song "Hunter" instead of Björk. While Mark Bell was the producer and co-writer, Björk is the primary performer of the song. The mistake occurred when the Planner applied a heuristic to exclude Björk and incorrectly concluded Mark Bell was the performer, leading to the wrong birthplace being reported as Leeds, England instead of Reykjavík, Iceland.
